portfolio.title: Apartments, villas and chalets across Italy
portfolio.subtitle: Browse by area: city, mountains, sea. Every property has its own story and its own scale.

shortLets.title: Short lets
shortLets.desc: We handle every operational aspect of the property: bookings, check-ins, cleaning, maintenance and tax obligations. The owner attends to the property, we to everything else.

restyling.title: Interior restyling
restyling.desc: Where needed, we oversee the refurbishment of the property to make it more welcoming, from small improvements to complete restyling, working with local craftspeople and professionals.

photos.title: Photography and listings
photos.desc: We produce professional photography and carefully written copy, and make sure the property is present on the most suitable channels, with constant attention and without excess.

about.title: Methodical management. Satisfied clients.
about.body: We work with a limited number of owners so that we can give real time to every property. We use tools and automation to improve the guest experience, without giving up attentive, personal management.

hero.title:
One team,

properties looked after one by one.
hero.body: Ultralight Home was founded in 2021 by Alberto Cavinato and Alberto Disarò to offer careful, personalised management of every property.

story.title: One property in Sottomarina, then everything else.
story.body: We began with an apartment in Sottomarina let out seasonally, building our way forward steadily and with real passion until we reached the chalets in the Dolomites and villas on the Costa Smeralda.

0.title: Contact
0.desc: Every collaboration begins with meeting the owner in person: only by knowing one another properly can we build a solid relationship and truly understand their needs and their goals.

1.title: Property valuation
1.desc: Through a comparative analysis of the local market we establish the property's real income potential and the most effective strategy to maximise it.

2.title: Care
2.desc: We turn to local craftspeople and interior design professionals whenever the property calls for it, to make the most of every room.

3.title: Operations
3.desc: We handle every operational aspect of the property with complete autonomy, giving the owner a quarterly report on the results, on time.

discretion.title: And then there is discretion.
discretion.body: Discretion is something that goes beyond the work itself. It means choosing guests carefully, managing every property with care and protecting the confidentiality of your data.

where.title: An office in the heart of Verona.
where.body: We receive visitors by appointment at our office in the centre. Arrange an appointment and let's talk about your property in person.

privacy.title: Privacy policy.
privacy.intro: This notice describes how we process the personal data collected through this website, pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (“GDPR”) and to the applicable Italian legislation.

controller.heading: 1. Data controller
controller.body: The data controller is {owner}, VAT No. {vat}, with registered office at {address}.
controller.contact: For any request concerning your data you can write to <mail>{email}</mail>.

items.0: Contact form data: first and last name, email address and the content of the message you send us.
items.1: Browsing data: technical data collected automatically by the servers (e.g. IP address, access logs) for the operation and the security of the site.

items.0: Replying to your requests and managing enquiries — legal basis: performance of pre-contractual measures and legitimate interest (art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR).
items.1: Ensuring the security and the correct operation of the site — legitimate interest (art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
items.2: Complying with legal obligations — art. 6(1)(c) GDPR.

retention.heading: 4. Data retention
retention.body: We retain contact form data for as long as necessary for the purposes indicated and in any case for no longer than {retention} from our last exchange with you, save for different legal obligations. The technical server logs are retained by the hosting provider for shorter periods.

recipients.heading: 5. Data recipients
recipients.intro: The data may be processed by suppliers who support us in providing the service, appointed as data processors pursuant to art. 28 GDPR. We do not sell your data to third parties. The suppliers currently used are:

items.0: Cloudflare, Inc. — site hosting and infrastructure protection. Processes browsing data (IP address, technical logs). Privacy policy.
items.1: Resend (Plus Five Five, Inc.) — delivery of the emails generated by the contact form. Processes name, email address and message content. Privacy policy.

recipients.transfers: Both suppliers are based in the United States: the transfer takes place on the basis of the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission and, where applicable, of the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework certification.
recipients.maps: The Locations page embeds a Google Maps map (Google Ireland Ltd.), loaded only with your prior consent: in that case Google may process data, including transfers to the United States, in compliance with the safeguards provided for by the GDPR. Further information in the Cookie Policy.

rights.heading: 6. Your rights
rights.body: You have the right of access to your data, to request its rectification or erasure, to restrict or object to the processing, and the right to data portability (arts. 15-22 GDPR). You can exercise these rights by writing to <mail>{email}</mail>.
rights.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority, Garante per la protezione dei dati personali (<link>garanteprivacy.it</link>).

cookies.heading: 7. Cookies
cookies.body: The use of cookies is described in our <cookies>Cookie Policy</cookies>.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie policy.
cookiePolicy.intro: Cookies are small text files that websites save on the user's device. They can be technical (necessary for the site to work) or profiling cookies (to track browsing habits).

technical.heading: 1. Technical cookies
technical.body: For its own operation this site uses exclusively technical and necessary cookies. We do not use profiling cookies or statistical analysis tools for marketing purposes. The fonts are hosted directly on our site and involve no requests to external servers.
technical.listIntro: The technical cookies set by this site are:

items.0: NEXT_LOCALE — remembers the language you chose for the site. Duration: {days} days. Category: technical/necessary; no consent required.

technical.storage: Your choice about third-party cookies is saved in the browser's local storage (key ulh-consent): it stays on your device, it is not transmitted to our servers and you can delete it by clearing the site data from your browser.

thirdParty.heading: 2. Third-party cookies — Google Maps
thirdParty.body: On the Locations page we embed a Google Maps map. This service, provided by Google Ireland Ltd., may install third-party cookies and process data (including the IP address), with possible transfers to the United States.
thirdParty.consent: The map is not loaded automatically: a preview is shown instead, and Google's content — with the related cookies — is activated only after your explicit consent, given through the banner that can be recalled from the “Manage cookies” button.
thirdParty.google: For details on the processing carried out by Google, see <link>Google's privacy policy</link>.

consent.heading: 3. Managing consent
consent.body: On your first visit a banner appears that lets you accept or decline third-party cookies. Google Maps cookies are installed only if you give your consent. You can change your choice at any time through the “Manage cookies” link in the footer of every page.

browser.heading: 4. How to manage cookies in your browser
browser.body: You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Disabling technical cookies may impair some functions of the site.

updates.heading: 5. Updates
updates.body: Should we introduce new third-party tools that use non-technical cookies, we will update this notice. For questions: <mail>{email}</mail>.

subject.heading: 1. Subject
subject.body: This site showcases the properties managed for short stays by {owner}, VAT No. {vat}, with registered office at {address}. Browsing the site implies acceptance of these terms.

bookings.heading: 2. Bookings
bookings.body: Property bookings take place through the linked third-party platforms (e.g. Airbnb). The terms, conditions and cancellation policies of the relevant platform apply. The information published here (availability, prices, features) is for illustrative purposes and may change.

intellectualProperty.heading: 3. Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: Texts, images, trade marks and logos on the site are the property of the owner or of the respective right holders and may not be reproduced without authorisation.

liability.heading: 4. Limitation of liability
liability.body: We undertake to keep the content up to date and accurate, but we do not guarantee the absence of errors or the uninterrupted availability of the site. We are not liable for any damage arising from the use of, or the inability to use, the site or the linked third-party sites.

law.heading: 5. Governing law and jurisdiction
law.body: These terms are governed by Italian law. The court of {court} has jurisdiction over any dispute, without prejudice to the mandatory rules protecting consumers.

contact.heading: 6. Contact
contact.body: For any question about these terms: <mail>{email}</mail>.
